0022600208.text: The Nuggets (5-3, 3-1 on the road, on a two-game win streak) visit the Houston Rockets (7-3, 4-1 at home, on a two-game losing streak) in a matchup of teams that have each played several games this season. Denver is 4th in the Northwest, 2 games back, and ninth in the West, while Houston is 2nd in the Southwest, 1 game back, and sixth in the West. Julian Strawther is out for Denver with a knee sprain, and Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain), Oscar Tshiebwe (illness), and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Nuggets won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 129-93 win in Denver in their most recent meeting.
